title: SelCal M6-P1 artifact contract v3 proposal
description: Closed proposal schema for M6-P1 reference, comparison, diagnostic, and failure artifacts.
x-claimCeiling: Schema validity can establish only local structural conformance. It cannot establish semantic digest correctness, numerical agreement, scientific validation, M6 completion, release approval, or SoftwareX readiness.

x-canonicalization.jsonObjectBytes: UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); JSON files have no BOM and no trailing LF
x-canonicalization.jsonlRowBytes: canonical JSON object bytes followed by exactly one LF byte; no blank rows; final row also has LF
x-canonicalization.fileSha256Domain: all raw bytes from byte zero through EOF
x-canonicalization.rowSha256Domain: one complete canonical JSONL row including its terminating LF
x-canonicalization.ledgerSha256Domain: raw chunk bytes concatenated in ascending chunkIndex without separators
x-canonicalization.projectionSha256Domain: canonical productionProjection object bytes without LF
x-canonicalization.noSelfHash: No manifest contains its own digest. A successful terminal comparison manifest binds primary and optional diagnostic manifests; a failed terminal failure manifest binds retained artifacts but not itself.

x-semanticVerifier.name: verify_m6_p1_artifact_contract_v3_semantics
requirements: recompute every descriptor bytes and SHA-256 over the declared byte domain
require state rowIndex to be exactly 0..T-1 for ALL_STATE_EXACT or 0..B-1 for FINITE_B_SCHEDULE across ordered chunks
require schedule-spool rowIndex and finite state rowIndex to be identical one-to-one and preserve repeated state labels
require block state order to be a permutation of 0..q-1 and state membership to satisfy the reference specification
require candidateIndex 0..C-1 and candidate equal referenceSpec.candidates[candidateIndex]
require exact identity row tailIndicator null; require finite tailIndicator null when observed is analytically failed
require comparisonIndex exact state rows 0..T-1 plus aggregate T; finite observed 0, state rowIndex+1, aggregate B+1
require chunkIndex continuity, contiguous nonoverlapping index ranges, row counts, and ledger digests
recompute validReplicateCount, E, F, numerators, denominators, bounds, p-values, and decisions from retained rows
require productionReplicateId equal finite rowIndex while retaining both names
require diagnosticIndices and comparisonIndex links to resolve and require every disagreement to retain adverse evidence
require comparison-manifest.json and failure-manifest.json to be mutually exclusive terminal roots
require no COMPLETE comparison manifest to reference partial diagnostics or partial comparison artifacts
